p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    b = base % MOD
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * b) % MOD
        b = (b * b) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
elif k == 1:
    print(mod_pow(p, p))
else:
    used = [False] * (p + 1)
    answer = 1
    for x in range(1, p):
        if used[x]:
            continue
        answer = (answer * p) % MOD
        v = x
        while not used[(v * k) % p]:
            used[(v * k) % p] = True
            v = (v * k) % p
    print(answer)
